text:
emily (marketing-ops): Noticed a small but steady stream of inbound leads landing unassigned this AM. Traced to enrichment webhook timeouts (15s). Example: `2026-03-24T09:12:04Z hubspot->enrich timeout lead 33221`

noah (revops): That 15s window was to reduce retries, but third-party firmo lookups sometimes take longer. How many?

emily (marketing-ops): ~86 in last 4h, 7 with MQLs and 1 flagged enterprise. If unowned they sit in the queue forever.

lina (sdr): Can we put a temporary owner earlier so SDRs at least see them? We're missing followups.

noah (revops): Quick patch idea: set owner to `SDR_RR_fallback` after 12s elapsed, add property `enrich_timedout=true`. If enrichment returns later, normal overwrite rules apply but SF upsert should ignore system fallback to avoid dupes.

mike (growth): +1. Also propose a 5% canary route for a single campaign so we can validate no double-creates in Salesforce. Add telemetry by campaign/utm.

emily (marketing-ops): I'll create the HS workflow change and a wiki playbook. HubSpot task created.

salesforce-bot: Connector note: skip owner upsert when `hs_owner_source=="system" AND hs_owner_id=="SDR_RR_fallback" AND enrich_timedout=="true"`.

lina (sdr): For SLA, request: if owner==SDR_RR_fallback -> 1hr ack from SDR_Triage. I'll patch rota.

noah (revops): Short-term plan: deploy fallback (canary 5%) in next 2 hours, SF guard in next deploy, increase webhook ack to 30s on staging for heavy-enrich tests, and add alert: enrich_latency_p50>8s or error_rate>1%.

emily (marketing-ops): Deployed canary at 10:45. Initial fallback rate 6 leads/hour, 0 dupes observed so far. Will close after 24h check.
